correctness.rationale: The stationary OU convolution gives C_N=U+σZ/√N with U=B(2T−1), T~Beta(ν,ν), and exact edge-distance density g(y)=cν y^{ν−1}(1−y/(2B))^{ν−1}. Substitute y=w/√N into the Gaussian survival integral and dominate the Gaussian tail to obtain compact-ξ uniform cν N^{−ν/2} Jν(ξ;σ). At ξ=0 Tonelli evaluates Jν(0;σ)=E[(σZ)_+^ν]/ν and yields the stated gamma coefficient. The joint unnormalized edge measure gives the conditional selected-center density w^{ν−1} Φbar(w/σ)/Jν(0), and overshoot survival is the ratio Jν(ξ)/Jν(0). For bounded positive exterior δ_N with √Nδ_N→∞, uniform Mills ratio then endpoint Laplace rescaling y=σ²t/(Nδ_N) yields cν Γν σ^{2ν+1}/(√(2π)δ_N^{ν+1})N^{−ν−1/2}exp(−Nδ_N²/(2σ²)); opposite edge by reflection. Independent ν=1 exact edge-convolution check agrees with asymptotic prefactor. This is not a statement uniform in changing model parameters.
